product_metadata.title: Aminno Oil Sprayer for Cooking, Food Grade Oil Sprayer Dispenser Mister, BPA-FREE Oil Spray Bottle, Multipurpose Sprayer for Air Fryer, Frying, Salad, Baking, BBQ, 7oz/200ml
features: 【FOOD GRADE OIL SPRAYER】This olive oil sprayer made by food grade plastic material, BPA-FREE. Strong and lightweight, portable and refillable oil sprayer

【MULTIPURPOSE OIL SPRAYER】Fill this sprayer with cooking oil, vinegar, lime juice, sherry wine, This oil sprayer will become your efficient tool for cooking, baking, salad making, roasting, grilling, frying, BBQ. Large opening mouth of bottle, no needed funnel when refilling

【LARGER OIL MIST】 The enhanced nozzle of this oil sprayer so that it can spray a larger and wider oil mist. Enhanced the food flavor and make the food more delicious. Meanwhile, the atomized oil is evenly distributed and covered on the food surface, thereby reducing oil output and calorie intake. Enjoy a low-fat healthy life

【LEAKPROOF】The specially designed lock will seal the bottle tightly to prevent leakage. (Note: When you open or close the Top-cap of the sprayer bottles, press down slightly and turn it, until you hear a click, it is locked or opened.)

【CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE】Please use soft cloth to wash by hand and clean with a neutral detergent. with under 50℃/122℉ warm water(Don't put it in dishwasher). Be sure to clean and dry it after use each time. please fill liquid/oils that does not contain particles. Due to the different viscosity of oils, the spray pattern may be slightly different
